combat_progression.rationale: Full credit for substantial implemented combat depth and escalation.
evidence: src/main.js:307-328 defines scout, weaver, and tank enemies with distinct health, speed, movement, and firing behavior.
src/main.js:405-480 implements projectile/enemy collisions, score awards, enemy fire, missed-enemy damage, and player collision damage.

src/main.js:504-519 increases wave level by time or score, accelerates spawning, and adds double spawns at higher levels; automated.json records live enemies and projectiles plus a real game-over state.

visual_design.rationale: Strong, cohesive neon arcade art direction with clear state feedback and responsive composition; a minor mobile overlay collision prevents full credit.
evidence: desktop-before.png visibly shows a coherent cyan/pink/yellow-on-navy visual system, grid and star-field canvas, structured HUD, leaderboard, and briefing card.
desktop-after.png visibly shows STANDBY changing to ENGAGED, SOUND ON changing to SOUND OFF, TOP 3 changing to TOP 4, and the glowing interceptor rendered in the active canvas.

mobile.png visibly shows a responsive single-column layout with touch movement/fire controls and stacked leaderboard/briefing cards, but the ready-copy lower line is partially covered by the launch button.
src/main.js:532-739 implements animated stars, glows, ship/enemy forms, projectiles, particles, floating score text, hit flashes, and screen shake.

resilience_accessibility.rationale: Full credit for graceful loading/offline/error paths and strong baseline labeling/focus support.
evidence: src/main.js:753-775 renders loading, empty, offline, and error leaderboard states; src/main.js:806-858 adds a 9-second abort timeout and user-facing network degradation messages.
src/main.js:861-914 validates names, focuses the invalid input, handles local fallback, submission failures, and retryable status feedback.

index.html:100-176 provides a labeled score form, live status regions, labeled touch controls, and refresh control; src/styles.css:54-58 and 1272-1280 provide focus-visible styling and reduced-motion handling.
automated.json reports basic_accessible_labels passed with 7 labeled elements and browser_error_free passed with zero console/page errors.

data_security.rationale: Full credit: the migration defines server-side validation, RLS, least-privilege public grants, and server-owned columns, while retained remote evidence confirms the deployed read/insert path.
evidence: supabase/migrations/20260807000000_create_leaderboard.sql:7-24 defines identity/timestamp ownership and database checks for name length, trimming, control characters, and integer score bounds.
supabase/migrations/20260807000000_create_leaderboard.sql:36-56 revokes broad privileges, grants only SELECT and column-limited INSERT, enables RLS, and creates only public read/insert policies.
src/main.js:38-40 and 821-825 use only Vite-injected public Supabase URL/key values; no service-role credential is used in browser code.

automated.json and browser-evaluator.log record anonymous GET 200, POST 201, subsequent GETs, and persisted leaderboard data; tests/leaderboard-migration.test.mjs:31-63 checks the RLS, grants, server-owned columns, and credential-material contract.

engineering_quality.rationale: Build, lockfile, and static data-contract tests are solid, and the source is organized into clear functions; points are withheld for limited test depth and the large single-module implementation.
evidence: build.log shows a successful Vite production build in 384ms and build.exit-code is 0.
test.log shows four passing Node tests and test.exit-code is 0; the tests meaningfully cover the migration contract but do not exercise gameplay or a real local database.
package.json pins Vite 5.4.14 and package-lock.json uses lockfileVersion 3.
src/main.js is a roughly 1030-line single module; no lint/typecheck script or gameplay unit tests are present.

reproducibility.rationale: The handoff is highly reproducible beyond the result artifact, with one point withheld because README lacks an explicit controls section/local run command.
evidence: README.md:1-138 documents local Supabase setup, architecture, security decisions, quality checks, Cloudflare deployment, and production verification.
supabase/migrations/20260807000000_create_leaderboard.sql and deployment/verify.sh provide a reproducible schema and HTTP/read/insert/persistence verification workflow.
source-manifest.txt lists the source, build output, package files, migration, tests, deployment script, and configuration retained with the candidate.
README.md does not explicitly document WASD/Arrow/Space or touch controls, and does not provide a dedicated local frontend run command.
